source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: ICSE Class IX school annual examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'Annual Examination 2023-2024', 'Class- IX', 'Physics', 'Time- 2:00 hours.', 'Marks- 80'; examYear 2024 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name). Section I (40 marks, attempt all): Q1-Q4; Section II (40 marks): attempt any four of Q5-Q10, so the pack's marks total (100) exceeds the 80 maximum. Q1 prints only a group total [10] for its ten parts (five MCQs and five fill-in-the-blanks), so it is kept as one entry. The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images. Some mark brackets in Q8-Q9 are printed offset from their parts. Q4(c), Q4(d), Q10(a) are on static electricity, which has no chapter in the list (chapter null). No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
